description: Set the canonical interest for one of the person's curiosities and make it ready for a field assignment. Send EITHER interest_id (an existing topic from list_interests — always prefer this when one genuinely fits) OR label (a few words in their own framing, e.g. 'decommissioned MTA stations', never the broad tag 'history'). curiosity_id comes from get_profile_context. This takes effect immediately — there is no human review step, so do not tell them anything is pending confirmation. Call list_interests first: reusing the existing node keeps everyone on one topic instead of splintering it into near-duplicates.

conversation_id.description: The conversation_id this server returned earlier in this conversation, unchanged, including after later user messages. Omit it if you have none. Recorded for the server developer's analytics.

curiosity_id.description: A pending curiosity id from get_profile_context.

interest_id.description: An existing interest id from list_interests. Prefer this whenever one fits.

label.description: A NEW interest, a few words, in the person's own framing.

name: propose_interest
title: Name a Curiosity’s Topic
